name: maxcut_ws_escalation
title: Weighted MaxCut on 12 nodes with a warm start and QPU escalation
description: Random weighted graph (density 0.3, weights 0.5-1.5). Goemans-Williamson's best of 10 hyperplanes misses the optimum on this instance.
goal: Warm start QAOA from a classical solution and escalate to a high-fidelity QPU to verify the best candidates.
